title: pixelNeRF
paper_title: pixelNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from One or Few Images
core_mech: pixelNeRF 将每个 3D 点与其投影像素的 CNN 特征绑定，使 NeRF 从单场景优化器变为跨场景条件模型。
core_mech_en: Conditions a coordinate NeRF MLP on pixel-aligned 2D CNN feature vectors projected from 1 or a few input views, turning NeRF from a per-scene optimizer into a feed-forward cross-scene prior.
input_desc: 一张或少量带相机位姿的参考图像，以及目标相机射线
input_en: 1 to K calibrated input images + query 3D point x projected into each input view's camera coordinates
output_desc: 目标视角 RGB 图像和隐式密度/辐射场
output_en: Feed-forward novel-view rendering and 3D volumetric density field from sparse views

adapter.name: pixelNeRF
adapter.mechanism: Project world points into a known reference camera, sample aligned CNN features and condition a radiance field for a new view.
limitations: Single reference view, small encoder/MLP and synthetic scenes; no original ResNet encoder or multiview feature aggregation.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
